_doc: A cohort boundary is NOT always a prompt bump. The agentic arm's query_prices
returned [] from deploy (the substrate was never packaged), so the arm was
PRICE-BLIND while carrying prompt_version daily_agentic/v1 the whole time —
by_prompt_version cannot see that boundary, because the prompt never changed.
Each boundary splits one source's record at a DATE. Rows on or after `from_date`
take the cohort's label; earlier rows take the prior cohort's. Labels are NEVER
retroactively reinterpreted (the risk_flags canonicalization rule): a price-blind
row stays price-blind forever, because that is what the arm actually saw.
E: when the packaging fix deploys, set `from_date` on the price_fed cohort to the
DEPLOY DATE as a stamped fact. Until then it stays null and every agentic row is
price_blind — which is the honest default, not a placeholder.

cohorts.label: price_blind
cohorts.note: query_prices returned [] since deploy — the arm could not see prices at all

cohorts.label: price_fed
cohorts.note: E stamps the packaging-fix DEPLOY DATE here; null = not yet deployed
